references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) ss.61, 65, 68
references.quote: Working-day overtime is at least 1.5 times the hourly wage; the monthly hourly wage is the monthly wage divided by 30 times the normal hours a day; s.65(2)-(8) work is paid 1 time; a s.65(1) manager gets none.

description: Normal working-day overtime hours, paid at the statutory multiplier.

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) ss.62, 66
references.quote: Holiday work in normal hours is at least 1 time the hourly wage when the holiday is paid and 2 times when it is unpaid; a s.65(1) manager gets none unless agreed.

description: Hours worked on a statutory holiday, paid at the statutory holiday multiplier.

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) ss.63, 65
references.quote: Overtime on a holiday is at least 3 times the hourly wage; s.65(2)-(8) work is paid 1 time; a s.65(1) manager gets none.

description: Overtime hours worked on a statutory holiday, paid at the holiday-overtime multiplier.
